## Review checklist

- [ ] Confirm whether the source is official conference content, Teams/internal discussion, or partner-provided detail.
- [ ] Decide whether the guide needs an update.
- [ ] If an update is needed, create a branch/PR rather than editing the published guide directly.
- [ ] Re-run guide validation before publishing.

## Publishing guardrails

- Do not infer missing event details.
- Do not publish Teams-only details externally unless approved.
- Do not bypass Microsoft 365 access policy.
- Keep VibeHub deployment separate until approved.
